headline: Approved library bills totaling $172,270.42 and $502.63, plus $1,700 in trust and donation spending
summary: The board approved payment of library bills, approved spending from donation and trust funds, and approved the August 4, 2026 meeting minutes. The board also heard a presentation from designLAB Architects on the renovation project and discussed sustainability and resource center plans.
decisions: Approved payment of library bills from June through August 2026 totaling $172,270.42 from the regular budget and $502.63 from the fines account, 5-0.
Approved $700 from Miscellaneous Donations for catering and $1,000 from the Bloomfield Trust for Cuban-related discussions for the Nashua Reads program, 5-0.

plain_text:
Nashua Public Library Board of Trustees  
September 1, 2026  
7:00 PM  
MINUTES 
A meeting of the Nashua Public Library Board of Trustees was held Tuesday, September 1, 2026, 
scheduled at 7:00 PM at the Nashua Public Library, 2 Court Street, Nashua, NH, 03060  
1. Call to Order 
 
 Chairman Laflamme called the meeting to order at 7:01 PM. 
2. Attendance 
 
 Present: Linda Laflamme, Kristin Kane, Scott Jaquith, John Kennedy, Patricia Dresner, Library 
Director Jennifer McCormack, Assistant Library Director Jenn Hosking. 
 
Five members of the public. 
3. Public Comment 
 
 Tracy Kittredge spoke about the positive impact library staff have on the services they offer. 
 
Mark King read a letter from a library employee highlighting the high level of customer service staff 
provide to customers. 
4. Approval of bills and trust fund requests 
 
 Motion by Mr. Jaquith, seconded by Ms. Kane, to approve payment of the library bills from June 
through August 2026 from the regular budget for $172,270.42 and $502.63 from the fines account.  
 
Vote: Yes, 5, No, 0 
Motion: PASSED 
 
Motion by Ms. Kane, seconded by Mr. Jaquith, to approve $700 be expended from Miscellaneous 
Donations to purchase catering for a library staff meeting and $1,000 be expended from the 
Bloomfield Trust to fund two Cuban-related discussions related to the Nashua Reads program. 
 
Vote: Yes, 5, No, 0 
Motion: PASSED 
5. Approval of minutes from previous meeting 
 
 Motion by Mr. Jaquith, seconded by Mr. Kennedy, to approve the August 4, 2026 meeting minutes. 
 
Vote: Yes, 5, No, 0 
Motion: PASSED 
6. Presentation by Design Lab 
 
 Ben Youtz and Audrey Scanlon of designLAB Architects presented an update on the renovation 
project and a timeline for the next phase of design. 
7. Discussion of renovation topics : sustainability and resource center 
 
 Director McCormack stated there is no new information related to sustainability features in the new 
building architecture. Director McCormack also shared the City is exploring other options for 
placement of a resource center outside the library.
8. New Business 
 
 Chairman Laflamme announced the cancellation of the Joint Committee on Infrastructure and the 
Library Board of Trustees scheduled for September 9, 2026. 
9. Adjourn 
 
 Motion by Mr. Kennedy, seconded by Ms. Kane to adjourn the meeting at 8:55 PM. 
 
Vote: Yes, 5, No, 0 
Motion: PASSED
